I want Monday to feel like a real start, not just paperwork and a tour, so I carved out time to actually talk with you, not at you."}, {"phase": "Curiosity", "words": "Before I tell you anything, I want to ask: what does a good first few weeks look like to you? What would make you feel like you are actually contributing and not just getting oriented?"}, {"phase": "Collaboration", "words": "Here is what I am going to ask of you, and I want to be straight about it from the start. situation: A new hire starts Monday and I want to set clear expectations.
